_note: PAT-233. Same 7 patients and populations as scenario 19 (IP = adults, Denom = 50+, Numer = 65+, period ending 2022-06-30: p1 72M, p2 69M, p3 67F, p4 62F, p5 57F, p6 42M, p7 32F). Three stratifiers on one group: the classic boolean `gender` (group-level, `true` = male), plus two ARTIFACT-level value stratifiers built the way the eCQM workspace's Stratifiers tab builds them — `sex` (Patient.gender.value → female / male) and `age` (age bands 18-49 / 50-64 / 65+ at the end of the measurement period). Locks: (1) artifact-level stratifiers reach the published MeasureDefinition and the evaluation at all (they used to get a CQL define and nothing else); (2) a value stratifier's strata are the values, not true / false; (3) a FHIR primitive serialises as its value ('female', not 'FHIR.AdministrativeGender'); (4) per-stratum scores — 18-49 has an empty denominator so it has no score, which the assertion leaves unchecked on purpose; (5) exactStrata: no stratum beyond the listed ones (nobody lands in a 'null' or 'FHIR.code' bucket).
